propositions: Ship durable bridge status on all established entry points via canonical `rebar bridge status` and hidden compatibility alias `rebar bridge-status` using identical parser, options, output format, and exit codes.

Replace duplicate pass-record producers with one process-finalizer writer that advances `refs/reconciler/last-pass` via observed-OID CAS with exactly three attempts (100ms and 200ms backoff) before lock release, treating network/permission/contention failures as operational errors with nonzero exit.
Status reads last-pass and live lock in fast read-only snapshots without mutation, applying precedence PAUSED > RUNNING > FOREIGN > FAILED > STALE > HEALTHY to determine exit code and verdict.

Canary moves from GitHub Actions heartbeat polling to durable git state by reading `refs/reconciler/last-pass` and using two read-only snapshots across the lock-carried lease to detect stalled fence (CRASHED classification).

Derive stable local identity from checkout `.env-id` as `local:<repo-env-id>` (explicit `REBAR_ENV_ID` wins); missing/empty/.env-id is hard configuration error; preserve legacy `LEGACY_JIRA_ENV_ID=reconciler` and inbound event metadata unchanged.

ADR 0094 documents authoritative ref, rolling detail file, write-before-release order, stalled-fence witness, and extension of ADR 0031 live-fence/lease-blob/CAS-classifier precedent; numbering marker and generated index follow current convention and both checker commands pass.
